summary: Fourth straight consolidation day; Bank Nifty swung +/-300 intraday; both indices closed flat with positive bias. FIIs bought 3,600cr, DIIs booked ~400cr profit. Speaker expects next leg up after consolidation; range 20,500-21,500.

events.claim: Dec-2024 and Jun-2024 Nifty call premiums elevated on expectations BJP will win the May-2024 parliament election; Dec-24 25,000CE traded above 200
FIIs bought 3,600cr and DIIs sold ~400cr on 11-Dec-2023 during consolidation

lessons: The longer the consolidation in an uptrend, the more powerful the next leg tends to be.
Non-directional option sellers make steady money during consolidation; trends are what kill them.
quote: Unless market closes above 21,000, this consolidation may continue... 20,500 to 21,500 should be the range.
leaks: 'launched intraday option buying course... more than 2000 people attended'

summary: US indices at 52-week highs ahead of US CPI (today) and Fed (tomorrow). Nifty set to close above 21,000 for first time; post-state-election rally of ~2,200pts in 5 weeks with <10% correction. DIIs may press sell above 21,000; 20,800PE heavy OI; PCR 1.5.

events.claim: Nifty rallied ~2,150-2,200 points in 5 weeks (Nov 4 weeks + Dec 1 week) after state election results; Bank Nifty ~3,000 points
US CPI data due 12-Dec-2023 and Fed meeting 13-Dec-2023
20,800PE had huge weekly OI with Nifty near 21,000; put-call ratio ~1.5 (puts sold per call)

lessons: Never chase a rally; intraday 80-100 point dips and positional 250-300 point dips are the entries even in strong bull markets.
Momentum players must stay with momentum; India CPI barely moves the index but US CPI moves everything.
quote: Do not chase the markets, always wait for correction - intraday 80 to 100 point, positional 200 to 300 point.

summary: Fed-day preview: US at 52-week highs, status quo expected with hawkish tone. Corrects previous day's FII/DII data error - both were net buyers. India CPI came lower than expected. Axis Bank block deal ~4,000cr at 2% discount may hit Bank Nifty on its expiry day. Futures premium >100 signals bullish undercurrent.

events.claim: Axis Bank block deal of about 4,000 crore rupees planned at 2% discount (13-Dec-2023)
India CPI inflation came lower than expected (13-Dec-2023 report)
Nifty turned technically bullish above 19,530; every dip a buy until technicals turn bearish
Nifty future premium stayed >100 and next-month >120 late in the series - premium expansion read as bullish

lessons: Futures premium that refuses to decay late in a series is a bullish undercurrent signal.
Own data errors must be corrected openly next session - trust compounds.
quote: When the Nifty crossed 19,530 the market became technically long - every dip is a buying opportunity.

summary: Fed delivered dovish pivot - two rate cuts signalled for 2024; GIFT Nifty +200 on Bank Nifty weekly expiry. Call writers trapped; far-OTM put premiums rise on gap-ups as sellers defend. FIIs bought 4,000cr despite Axis block deal. 2023 arc: 16,800 to 20,200 to 18,850 to 21,200.

events.claim: Fed signalled two rate cuts in the next year at the 13-Dec-2023 meeting - major dovish pivot
S&P 500 rose ~15% in six weeks around the Fed pivot
FIIs bought ~4,000cr on 13-Dec-2023 despite the Axis Bank block deal; DIIs sold ~1,000cr
2023 pattern: March expiry low 16,800, October-expiry area 20,200, correction to 18,850, then 21,200

lessons: A vertical rally traps new call sellers; their forced covering propels the market higher - classic bull-market mechanics.
On a big gap-up, far out-of-the-money put premiums rise, not fall, as writers defend with hedges.
quote: If you can't beat them, join them - Powell stopped fighting the bulls and announced two rate cuts.

summary: Raging bull: 250-point correction erased in one session; Nifty future premium 150 points with 9 sessions left (Bank Nifty 325). 21,000 straddle sellers badly hurt (call +230 vs put -93). Speaker calls it the hardest month for option writers; announces Dubai traders meet and a paid directional course.

events.claim: Nifty future premium 150pts and Bank Nifty future 325pts with only 9 sessions to expiry - extreme short-covering
21,000 short straddle: call up 230 while put fell only 93 - asymmetric premium damage to sellers
FIIs +3,500cr, DIIs +500cr on 14-Dec-2023

lessons: Pure short-premium positions die in violently trending months; only directional players made money in December 2023.
Futures premium blowouts near expiry mark short-covering, not fresh buying - expect mean reversion in premium.
quote: These straddles, strangles - nothing works. The call premium shoots up but the put premium does not come down.
leaks: Dubai traders meet + sponsorship fee 5000 dirham

summary: US quadruple witching day explained (index futures/options + stock futures/options expire together). Nifty future ~1% premium two weeks out = ~24% annualized - textbook cash-futures arbitrage case. Election-year pattern: markets rise 10-11% in the 6 months before polls. Large caps lag since Oct-2021 peak.

events.claim: 15-Dec-2023 was US quadruple witching (quarterly index + stock futures/options expiry)
Nifty future ~1% premium to spot with 2 weeks to expiry implies ~24% annualized, inviting cash-futures arbitrage
Historical pattern: Indian markets rise ~10-11% in the six months before a parliament election (last ~50 years)
Nifty returned only ~16% from its Oct-2021 peak to Dec-2023 (~8% annualized)

lessons: When futures premium annualizes far above interest rates, arbitrage capital arrives and forces convergence - spot up or futures down.
Seasonality memory: election anticipation, not the result itself, drives the pre-poll rally.
quote: Buy the Nifty BeES in cash and short the future - you get 24 percent risk-free if this premium holds.
leaks: 'since I am under SEBI ban, I cannot trade... I have to make money only through these courses' - self-referential regulatory claim

summary: Santa rally rewarding investors, call buyers and put sellers: Nifty +500 in two sessions, ~1,200 points in five. India VIX rose 6%+ for a second straight day on a rising market - fear has shifted to call writers. IT stocks ferocious (Infosys ~8% in 2 days). Put writing shifted 21,500 to 21,200.

events.claim: Nifty rose >500 points in two sessions after the Fed meeting; ~1,200 points in five sessions from state-election results
India VIX rose more than 6% for a second consecutive day while the market rose
Infosys gained ~8% in two trading sessions (15-18 Dec 2023)

lessons: VIX rising with the market means fear sits with call writers - the crowd is positioned for falls that are not coming.
Violent moves kill writers on both sides: those who lost on calls sold puts to recover, doubling exposure before reversals.
quote: Ruthless markets - the market will kill you on both sides.
leaks: 'Mr. Sundar talks more about his workshop than stock market'

summary: Seven straight up weeks in the US, six in India (+2,500 points) - market desperately needs consolidation. GIFT -60/70 read as healthy. HDFC Bank and ICICI ADRs lower. New-age stocks under block-deal selling (Paytm, PB Fintech, Zomato); BAT reportedly may trim ITC stake. FIIs bought 9,000cr on Friday.

events.claim: FIIs bought more than 9,000cr on Friday (15-Dec-2023)
British American Tobacco, a large ITC shareholder, signalled intent to bring down its stake
Block/bulk deal selling in new-age stocks: Paytm, PB Fintech, Zomato (mid-Dec-2023)

lessons: After a vertical multi-week rally, even a small gap-down is healthy - cooling call premiums, not damage.
Low-PE, high-dividend large caps beat hyped high-valuation new-age names over time.
quote: Wherever there is a huge valuation, better to avoid - low PE with high dividend yield can offer a decent return.
leaks: 'I have always been cautioning my followers'

summary: Consolidation day, but VIX spiked 7%+ contrary to expectation; far-month call premiums rose 20-30 even as Nifty slipped ~40. Futures premium compressed 150 to 40-50 (Bank Nifty 300 to 30-40) - spot falls less than futures. Suggests long-dated call ratio: buy Dec-24 20,000CE, sell 2-3x 23,000CE, upper breakeven ~24,500.

events.claim: Nifty fell ~40 points on 18-Dec-2023 while far-month call premiums rose 20-30 rupees; India VIX spiked >7% intraday
Nifty futures premium collapsed from ~150 to 40-50 points; Bank Nifty futures from ~300 to 30-40 points
FIIs sold 30cr; DIIs bought 400cr (18-Dec-2023)

lessons: During consolidation after a vertical rally, both call and put premiums inflate - IV, not direction, moves prices.
When futures premium compresses, spot falls less than futures - long-futures holders lose even in flat markets.
quote: Option prices always track the future prices - the future fell 90 while spot fell 40.

summary: GIFT flat after FII selling post-9,000cr buying day; heavy intraday volatility expected on the (financials) expiry. 21,500 straddle ~323 implies a max ~300-point move expectation. Gamma-effect warning near expiry. Windfall tax cut on lower crude; Reliance+HDFC ~25% index weight anchor. Range 21,200-21,800 by expiry.

events.claim: Government reduced windfall tax as crude fell from ~95 to ~75 dollars (mid-Dec-2023 revision)
HDFC Bank + Reliance together ~25% of Nifty weight; both firm pre-open
21,500 short straddle priced ~323 rupees, implying a ~300-point expected monthly move

lessons: Near expiry, gamma punishes short options violently - conservative writers sell strikes 400-500 points away.
Index anchors: when the top two heavyweights hold firm, broad correction risk is limited.
quote: The bull market will last until the last bear is killed - and some people are still bearish.
leaks: 'just for fun I tweeted' social-media reference

summary: Worst fall of the rally with no trigger: Nifty -500 from high to low, Bank Nifty ~-1,000; mid/small caps -5% high-to-low. Institutions net +3,400cr yet market crashed - positioning, not flows, drove it. One year's expected move (2,000-2,200pts) had happened in one month (18,850 to 21,500+). Closed ~21,101.

events.claim: 20-Dec-2023: Nifty fell ~500 points intraday high-to-low and Bank Nifty ~1,000; mid/small-cap indices fell ~5% high-to-low
Nifty closed at ~21,101 on 20-Dec-2023
FIIs sold 1,300cr; DIIs bought 4,700cr on 20-Dec-2023
December rally covered 2,600+ points (18,850 to 21,500+) - a full year's expected move (VIX-implied 2,000-2,200) in one month

lessons: When a market delivers its whole year of expected movement in one month, mean reversion risk is extreme - book profits into strength.
Vertical rallies fall vertically; the crash needs no news trigger, only stretched positioning.
quote: What Nifty should move in one year, it moved in one month - naturally some people will book profits.

summary: Ripple day two: US S&P fell ~2% high-to-low after 9 straight up sessions (+15% in 2 months) ahead of US GDP. India's fall was positioning-driven - DIIs bought 4,500cr at the top. Short sellers, not long liquidation, extend such falls; DIIs' buying at ATH is a big positive. Watch 21,000 support.

events.claim: S&P 500 fell ~2% intraday high-to-low on 20-Dec-2023 after 9 consecutive up sessions and +15% in two months
US GDP data released 21-Dec-2023 (an hour before the US open)
On 20-Dec-2023 FIIs sold ~1,000cr while DIIs bought ~4,500cr

lessons: When longs cut positions, markets fall; when shorts then pile in, falls extend - the second phase, not the first, is the killer.
Institutional buying at all-time highs signals support beneath the market.
quote: Markets don't fall when people cut positions - they fall when shorts pile on afterwards.

summary: V-shaped snapback: Nifty +300 low-to-high; Bank Nifty +1,200 intraday - a move seen only on the 2019 finance-minister-appointment day. HDFC Bank and Reliance (~25% weight) held firm pre-open. VIX crashed 4-5%. FIIs sold 1,600cr vs DII 1,400cr buying yet market soared - a trading market, not an investing one.

events.claim: 21-Dec-2023: Bank Nifty moved ~1,200 points intraday low-to-high, the largest since the 2019 FM-appointment candle
India VIX fell ~4-5% on 21-Dec-2023
FIIs sold ~1,600cr, DIIs bought ~1,400cr on 21-Dec-2023, yet indices surged

lessons: When flows and price decouple (net selling, market soaring), the market is being traded, not invested - respect positioning over flows.
HDFC Bank + Reliance holding flat on a weak pre-open is the tell that the market will not fall far.
quote: When money flows out and markets rise, our market is not about investment, it is all about trading.

summary: US now mirrors India's whipsaw. Four sessions left in the series; Nifty future still ~150 premium (January ~170) - extreme given expiry proximity. Christmas-week hedge-fund holidays thin participation; weekend risk before a long holiday decides who blinks. Range view 21,000-21,500 intact.

events.claim: Nifty future premium ~150 points with 4 sessions left; January future ~170 points premium
Hedge funds holiday between Christmas and New Year - thin participation window

lessons: Premium that persists into expiry week signals forced positioning, not fair value - expect violent convergence.
Before long weekends, whoever is uncomfortable - longs or shorts - blinks first; the last hour decides.
quote: Bull market corrections are fast and furious; bear market falls settle like a dead snake.

summary: Mayhem: Nifty swung 100+ points 5-6 times; Bank Nifty +600, -800, +600 then closed at day's low (-350). Four banks (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis) contributed 50+ points of Nifty's fall; IT supported (Infosys top, +22). FII -2,800cr vs DII +2,200cr. Suspects index-management selling by call writers ahead of PCE data.

events.claim: 22-Dec-2023: Bank Nifty fell ~350 points to close at day's low after +/-600-800 point swings
HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI and Axis Bank together contributed over 50 points of the Nifty fall; Infosys was top contributor (+22 points)
FIIs sold 2,800cr; DIIs bought 2,200cr on 22-Dec-2023

lessons: Large banks falling together on a good global tape often means derivative-driven index management, not fundamentals.
Thin holiday volumes exaggerate every institutional order - expect violence in both directions.
quote: Probably this is some index management by people who have sold call options.

summary: Holiday-week lull expected; volume low, volatility high. Infosys reportedly lost a ~$1.5bn AI-linked contract after a key employee left - panic possible at open. Mutual funds will defend prices into the 31-Dec NAV print. Advice: abandon December options (gamma) and shift to January series.

events.claim: Infosys lost a contract worth ~1.5 billion dollars (AI-related) in late Dec-2023 after a senior employee's exit
Mutual funds defend NAVs into 31-Dec year-end (window dressing)

lessons: Low-volume periods multiply volatility - cut size, not conviction.
Near expiry, roll exposure to the next series: gamma risk on decaying monthlies is not worth the last crumbs of theta.
quote: Whenever there is less volume, the volatility will be more.

summary: Consolidation with positive bias; Nifty +100, HDFC Bank-led Bank Nifty outperformed. India VIX jumped ~10% while Nifty rose - both far-month calls and puts inflated on January-move expectations. VIX band doctrine taught: <15 low, 15-30 moderate. Speaker cites a ~$75,000 loss in US markets with price going nowhere.

events.claim: India VIX rose ~10% on 26-Dec-2023 while Nifty rose ~100 points - both-side premium inflation
India VIX threatened to cross 15, the low-volatility boundary

lessons: VIX below 15 = stable markets; 15-30 = moderate volatility; use the band to pick strategy, not opinion.
When both calls and puts inflate, the market is pricing a January breakout - direction unknown, premium selling doubly dangerous.
quote: I lost nearly 75,000 US dollars without the market going anywhere - that is what high VIX does to writers.

summary: US firm; expiry convergence math (premium 50 today, ~25 tomorrow, 0 at expiry). India VIX now above US VIX - first time in months - India priced as the more volatile market. HDFC group rerating hope after 3 years of lag. 2008 Reliance Power IPO-crash anecdote; China -50% over 15 years vs India at highs.

events.claim: India VIX moved above US VIX (VIX) in late Dec-2023 - reversal of the usual relationship
Current account deficit narrowing (late 2023)
A ~1,200 crore IPO in Dec-2023 recalled the 2008 Reliance Power issue that coincided with a market top (name garbled - verify)
Shanghai Composite roughly -50% over 15 years; Nifty from ~6,000 (pre-Lehman) to 21,000+

lessons: Expiry convergence: futures premium decays linearly to zero - long-futures P&L lags spot near expiry.
When one market's VIX exceeds another's, option sellers should expect the premium regime, not the index direction, to differ.
The most expensive market keeps outperforming - relative valuation is a terrible timing tool.
quote: Chinese markets have given minus 50 percent in 15 years - that is how stock markets work.
leaks: 'I will come out with a detailed video later' cross-promo

summary: Breakout ignored the consolidation script: Bank Nifty +400-500 in the final 30 minutes on a non-expiry day; Nifty and Bank Nifty at fresh all-time highs; ~2,800-point monthly move. FIIs +2,900cr, DIIs only -200cr. Call buyers earning like post-COVID; a friend's trading loss offset by investing gains.

events.claim: 27-Dec-2023: Nifty and Bank Nifty hit fresh all-time highs; Bank Nifty +400-500 points in the last 30-35 minutes
FIIs bought ~2,900cr; DIIs sold ~200cr on 27-Dec-2023
Nifty moved ~2,800 points in the December series - a normal full-year move

lessons: No adjustment or firefighting works in a vertical market - the only defense is smaller size taken earlier.
Trading losses offset by long-term investing gains is the diversification lesson that actually pays.
quote: I have one friend who lost hugely in trading, but luckily an equivalent amount he made in investment.

summary: November 18,850 to 21,750: ~3,000 points (15%) in two months. Election outcome now largely priced - a thumping BJP win may add little. India VIX 15+ vs US VIX 13: rising VIX at highs crushes call writers. Suggests long-dated call ratio: buy 21,000CE, sell 2x 23,000CE (Dec-24), upper breakeven ~25,000.

events.claim: Nifty rallied ~3,000 points (~15%) from the November expiry close (18,850) to 28-Dec-2023
India VIX rose from below 11 to above 15 while US VIX fell from ~20-21 to ~13 over a month

lessons: Consensus is dangerous: when everyone agrees on the outcome, the event itself stops being a catalyst.
Markets price elections months early - trade the anticipation, exit into the event.
Rising VIX at market highs is a call-writer emergency, not a bear signal.
quote: Consensus is dangerous - when everybody thinks the market will only go up, that is when it shows its ugly face.
leaks: 'too many advertisements nowadays... intraday course, Dubai conference'

summary: A historic expiry: ~2,900-2,950 points in two months at all-time highs without a prior crash - unprecedented per speaker. Last 30 minutes: calls +80-100 while puts +10-15, then both collapsed 10-15 together (VIX mechanics). YTD ~3,500 points (~18-19%). June/Dec-24 premiums exploded (500 to 2,500 on some strikes).

events.claim: Nifty gained ~2,900-2,950 points in two months ending 28-Dec-2023, ~18-19% YTD
Post-election-expiry long-dated options saw premiums rise ~5x (e.g., 500 to 2,500)

lessons: At highs with no preceding crash, a two-month 15% rally is historically rare - treat velocity itself as risk.
VIX is computed from one-month premiums: wild last-half-hour two-sided moves reflect index math, not new information.
quote: Bull markets are always crazy - people who bought options at 500 saw 2,500.

summary: Last session of 2023. Data point: except 2012-13 and 2017, markets peaked in January (2008-2023 sample); uptrends last 10-12 weeks - this one is 8 weeks old. FIIs +4,000cr; MF NAV window-dressing supports. Nifty ~+20% YTD, midcaps ~+45%. Bank Nifty 44,000 to 48,500 in two months; RBI governor dovish on banks.

events.claim: FIIs bought more than 4,000cr on 28-Dec-2023
2023: Nifty ~+20%, midcap index ~+45%; 15% of Nifty's gain came in the final two months
Bank Nifty rose from ~44,000 to ~48,500 in under two months; RBI governor made dovish comments on banks
From 2008-2023, Indian markets peaked in January in all years except 2012-13 and 2017

lessons: Trends live 10-12 weeks on average - an 8-week-old trend is late-stage; protect gains, don't initiate.
Latecomers are not rewarded: the first 10 months gave 5%, the last 2 months gave 15%.
quote: If you're already long, take protection through options; if you're not, this is not the place to start.

summary: Year ends in consolidation: banks sold off ex-HDFC (Bank Nifty -400 high-to-low, +300 rebound), low volume amplified moves; VIX finally cooled and both calls and puts fell together. MFs defended NAVs into the close. Far-strike rule taught: if the highest listed strike still trades >100, that level will not be crossed.

events.claim: 29-Dec-2023: Nifty closed ~40-50 points lower on the final session of 2023; VIX cooled after many days
Feb-2024 highest listed call strike (23,200) traded above 100 - read as a ceiling that will not be crossed

lessons: When the extreme listed strike still carries >100 premium, the market is not going there - those premiums collapse.
Year-end window dressing: mutual funds support prices into the NAV print - fades of that support are low-probability.
quote: If the highest strike available is trading above 100, surely Nifty will not cross that.
leaks: 'I'm going for a party' personal aside

summary: India alone open globally - GIFT's 100-point gap-down print dismissed as illiquidity (static price for an hour). Friday had both FIIs and DIIs buying. Red Sea tensions yet crude <$80 - a gift for India. Pre-election petrol/diesel cut speculation (10 rupees). Auto in focus as the rates-plus-crude play; 2018-2022 was its downtrend.

events.claim: 1-Jan-2024: India the only major market open; GIFT Nifty quote static ~21,776 due to illiquidity
Red Sea shipping attacks continued but crude stayed below $80
Speculation of a 10-rupee petrol/diesel price cut ahead of the 2024 election
Tata Motors and Bajaj Auto were the best auto performers of 2023; auto sector in downtrend 2018-2022

lessons: Illiquid overnight index prints lie - check whether prices are actually trading before trusting the gap.
Auto is a two-variable trade: interest rates and crude. Both falling = structural tailwind.
quote: The bull face lasts until the last bear is killed; the bear face until the last bull is killed.

summary: First session folklore tested by chaos: Nifty +200 intraday, Bank Nifty +400; Nifty future crossed 22,000 (spot did not) at a 200+ premium - a personal first. Then a 30-minute late crash: Bank Nifty -400/500, HDFC Bank -15. DII +410cr vs FII -855cr. Cites 2011: FII selling in the first three sessions preceded a 20% annual correction.

events.claim: 1-Jan-2024: Nifty futures crossed 22,000 while spot did not; futures premium exceeded 200 points
Late-afternoon sell-off on 1-Jan-2024: Bank Nifty fell 400-500 points in ~30 minutes, led by HDFC Bank (-15 rupees)
FIIs sold 855cr; DIIs bought 410cr on 1-Jan-2024
In 2011, FIIs sold over 1,000cr in the first three sessions and Nifty corrected ~20% that year

lessons: Holiday-session moves distort: low volume can turn a trend day into noise - write the session off, not the thesis.
Futures leading spot by 200+ points marks speculative extension; convergence is coming for someone.
First-week FII behavior has historically foreshadowed the year (2011 case) - track it, don't trade it blindly.
quote: The very first trading session becomes an indication for the rest of the year - and what a session it was.
leaks: 'There is nobody at home, I am operating the camera' personal aside
